unit.title: Consider CUPED only with appropriate pre-experiment data

claim.text: The source says CUPED uses pre-experiment data as a covariate to strip out variance not caused by treatment; the adjusted estimator stays unbiased with lower variance, and Optimizely's glossary says it can cut sample requirements 30-50% for metrics with strong correlation to historical behaviour. DTC practicality is mixed because pre-period covariates are often missing or weakly correlated for new or anonymous checkout traffic.
claim.quote: Uses pre-experiment data (usually the same metric measured before the test) as a covariate to strip out variance not caused by the treatment.
